description: Combine the L2-prefetched cp.async n=512 plus cached direct-FP32 n=2048 global-best stack with the compile-time-specialized native-FP32 n=1024 triangular rank-k winner. Import only the three n=1024 stage operators and pointer cache, preserve n=512 launch caching and n=2048 state, then validate cross-shape resets, repeated outputs, caller-stream ordering, fresh inputs, every other dispatch, and the full grid.

Combined the three compile-time-specialized native-FP32 n=1024 triangular rank-k stages and cached panel/output pointers into the L2-prefetched n=512 plus cached direct-FP32 n=2048 parent, retaining every other dispatch. Full validation and all 15 benchmark checks passed; n=1024 batch60 measured 2101.403 us and the full-grid geomean measured 919.389 us.

Instantiated a stage-specific 1x1 cluster operation for the final 256x256 native-FP32 n=1024 rank-k update while retaining 2x1 operators for the larger stages. Modal CuTe compilation rejected the 1x1 cluster because the SM100 dense GEMM selects a 2x1 MMA atom; no benchmark metric was produced.

Hoisted caller-queue resolution to once per batch-60 n=1024 factorization and passed the cached CuTe queue to all three specialized native-FP32 rank-k launches. Full validation and grid checks passed; target batch60 n1024 measured 2101.957 us versus 2101.403, and aggregate measured 923.864 us versus 919.389 with untouched-cell variation.

Bound each specialized native-FP32 n=1024 rank-k callable together with its cached panel/output pointers, removing per-invocation stage indexing and the Python launch wrapper while retaining one caller-queue lookup. Validation and all grid checks passed; target batch60 n1024 measured 2101.289 us versus 2101.957, while aggregate measured 923.784 us amid slower unchanged n2048.

Replaced the id-keyed n=1024 stage-cache dictionary with one identity-checked entry reset on every shape transition, retaining bound native-FP32 callables, cached pointers, and fresh-input allocation. Validation and the repeated full-grid sequence passed; target batch60 n1024 measured 2101.544 us and aggregate measured 919.319 us.

Added a dedicated terminal batch-60 n=1024 factor writeback that reuses the transposed lower-copy kernel but omits the empty-panel TRSM pointer writes, on top of the single-entry bound native-FP32 stage cache. Validation and all 15 grid checks passed; target improved from 2101.544 to 2099.652 us and aggregate measured 916.865 us.

Combined the three compile-time native-FP32 n1024 rank-k stages into the L2-prefetched n512 plus cached direct-FP32 n2048 parent and measured six trials. Exact integration was 919.389 us with target 2101.403; a matching 1x1 final-stage operation was rejected because SM100 chose a 2x1 MMA atom; once-per-call queue lookup was 923.864/2101.957; bound stage callables 923.784/2101.289; a single identity-checked cache entry 919.319/2101.544; and dedicated terminal factor writeback reached 916.865 us with target 2099.652 at 3673c13fd1a22b569999f3d15a1e5f26929d55f5. Every succeeded trial passed build, policy gates, official validation, fresh-input guard, repeated execution, and all 15 benchmark cells; local profiling was waived. Keep this line moving with a diagonal-macrotile masked CuTe epilogue that removes final upper cleanup, a cluster-compatible final-stage kernel with a true one-CTA MMA atom, cached per-stage TRSM pointer tables, or a terminal writeback geometry sweep.
